rules.rule: When approval_binding is present, proposal_id, proposal_version, diff_digest, base_revision, source_revision, expected_campaign_head, expected_editor_workflow_version, authority_change_ids, visibility_change_ids, and warden_confirmed must equal the proposal values. approval_binding.validation_status and approval_binding.validation_digest must equal the sibling top-level validation.status and validation.validation_digest; only approving and approved states may carry a binding.
needs_review, approving, and approved proposals require validation.status passed and error_count zero.
Proposal changes are unique by change_id, even when duplicate change objects differ in another property.
